sources.quote: Context caching price | Not available | $0.31, prompts <= 200k tokens
sources.supports: Google's archived Gemini API pricing page on June 16, 2025 lists context caching at $0.31 per million tokens for prompts up to 200k, alongside the model's paid tier.

notes: The earlier cache_read omission was a models.dev fix: Google already listed context caching at $0.31 per million tokens on June 16, 2025, within the earlier recorded period. This price is for prompts up to 200k tokens; the archived page lists $0.625 above 200k.
